title: SDK Surface Release Orchestration — function-calls, streaming, structured outputs (docs + samples)
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Orchestrate the public launch of the SDK/API surface enhancements that enable function calling, structured output schemas, and streaming responses. This ticket covers launch planning, cross-team coordination (engineering, design, docs, developer relations, solutions), release notes and changelog coordination, sample app updates, and boxed guidance for customers migrating from v1 SDKs. Primary goals: ensure docs are accurate and runnable, samples demonstrate best practices for low-latency streaming + structured outputs, release notes clearly explain breaking/non-breaking changes and migration steps, and all required approvals & compliance checks are complete.
acceptance_criteria: Final docs pages for function calling, structured output, and streaming published to docs.redwood.ai
At least three sample apps (Node SDK streaming, Python structured-output example, Go function-calls sample) updated and passing CI in samples repo
Release notes draft reviewed and signed off by Eng, Design, Security, and DevRel
SDK versions published to npm/pypi with correct changelog entries and deprecation notices where applicable
Launch checklist completed and stakeholders notified (marketing, sales, support, security, partners)
tasks: Finalize function calling API examples and include JSON-schema examples for structured outputs
Coordinate streaming example that demonstrates chunked responses and reconnect behavior
Confirm kernel compatibility notes and runtime caveats for Dedicated & Private deployments
Prepare migration guide for existing customers using older streaming SDK semantics
Draft release notes and changelog; enumerate visible behavior changes and recommended mitigations
Create support playbook with common troubleshooting steps and known limitations
Schedule stakeholder review: Security (KMS/HSM implications), Legal (TOS updates), and Design (docs UX)
